visuals.heading: Weak Signal Vs Strong Signal, Compared

rows: No visible last-updated date; syllabus PDF looks identical to a 3-year-old version found elsewhere online
Module list shows a recent revision date and names current tools, frameworks, or AI-assisted workflows by name
Bio says "industry expert" with no name, no LinkedIn, no published work you can check
Named instructor with a searchable LinkedIn history, recent project work, and content you can verify independently of the course page
A single headline percentage with no sample size, no year, and no split between "placed" and "assisted with an internship"
A stated sample size, a named year, median (not just average) CTC, and a clear separation between full-time offers and internships
Only testimonials hosted on the provider's own page, all five stars, all vague ("changed my life")
Independent reviews on third-party forums or review sites, mentioning specific modules, specific instructors, and at least some criticism

items.heading: 4 You Checked At Least
items.text: 4 You checked at least one independent review, not just on-page testimonials On a third-party forum, review site, or professional community, mentioning specific modules or instructors rather than vague praise.

items.heading: 5 You Compared the Total
items.text: 5 You compared the total cost, including your time, against a cheaper alternative And can name specifically what the paid option buys you that the free or cheaper path cannot.

items.heading: 6 the Refund Policy
items.text: 6 The refund policy is clear, findable, and reasonable Not buried in a support ticket flow, and not conditional on requirements the marketing page never mentioned upfront.
